content: Addaameppe Biidi Abrahaame Gakkanaas Diza Yeleta
Addaamey Seete yelides; Seetey Heenoose yelides; Heenoosey Qaynaane yelides.
Qaynaaney Malal7eele yelides; Malal7eeley Yaareede yelides.
Yaareedey Heenooke yelides; Heenookey Maatusaala yelides; Maatusaalay Laameeke yelides.
Laameekey Nohe yelides; Nohey Seeme, Kaamenne Yaafeete yelides.
Yaafeetey, Goomere, Maagooge, Maadaye, Yaawaane, Tubaale, Mesheekenne Tiraase geetettiza attuma nayta yelides.
Goomere nayti Ashkenaaze, Erefasitenne Togarma.
Yaawaane nayti Elishe, Tarseese, Kiitimenne Oroodahime.
Kaame attuma nayti Kuushe, Mixirayme, Puuxenne Kanaane.
Kuushe nayti Seeba, Hawila, Saaba, Eraa7imenne Sabiteka; Eraa7ime attuma nayti Saabanne Dadaane.
Kuushey Namuruude yelides; Namuruudeyka alame bolla erettida wolqqama olanchcha gidides.
Mixiraymey Luudimeta, Anaameta, Lahaabeta, Naftuheta,
Phaxirooseta, Kaasiluhetanne Filisxeeme zareta yelida Kaftooreta yelides.
Kanaaney bayra naa Sidoonassinne iza kaalo Hiites aawa;
qasseka Kanaaney Yaabusetas, Amooretas, Gergesetas,
Hiiwetas, Arqetas, Siinetas,
Arwaadetas, Xamaaretassinne Hamaatetas aawa.
Seeme nayti, Elaame, Asoore, Arfaakiside, Luude, Aaraame, Uuxe, Huule, Geterenne Mesheeke;
Arfaakisidey Sheelahe yelides; Sheelahey Eboore yelides;
Eboorey nam7u attuma nayta yelides; issoy yelettida wode sa7ay shaakettida gishshas iza sunththi Peeleege geetettides; nam7anththozi Yoqixaane geetettides.
Yoqixaaney Almodaade, Shelefe, Haxarmaawete, Yerahe
Hadoraame, Uzaale, Diiqile
Eebaale, Abima7eele, Saaba,
Ofire, Hawilanne Yobaabe yelides; hayti wurikka Yoqixaane nayta.
Seemeppe biidi Abrahaame gakkanaas diza yeleta zarkkey hayssafe kaalli dizayta oykkees; isttika Seeme, Arfaakiside, Sheelahe,
Eboore, Peeleege, Era7e,
Saruge, Naakoore, Taaranne
guyeppe Abrahaame geetettida Abraame.
Abrahaame Soo Asata
Abrahaamey Yisaaqanne Isma7eele yelides.
Aggaara Abrahaames Yelida Nayta
Abrahaamey Aggaarippe Isma7eele yelides; Isma7eeley yelida bayra naaza sunththi Nebayoote gidishin iza kaaloti Qeedaare, Adibi7eele, Mibisaame, Mishima7e, Duuma, Maasa, Hadaade, Teema,
Yixure, Nafishaanenne Qeedima geetetteettes.
Keexuray Abrahaames Yelida Nayta
Keexuray Abrahaames yelida usuppun attuma nayti Zimiraane, Yoqishaane, Maadda, Midiyaane, Yishibaaqenne Shuha geetetteettes. Yoqishaaney Saabanne Dadaane geetettiza nam7u attuma nayta yelides.
Midiyaaneykka Eefa, Efere, Heenooke, Abida7enne Elda7e geetettiza ichchashu attuma nayta yelides; hayti ubbay Keexura zereththata.
Abrahaamey Saarappe Yelida Zareta
Abrahaamey Saarappe Yisaaqa yelides; Yisaaqi Eesawenne Isra7eele yelides.
Eesawey Elfaaze, Era7u7eele, Ya7uushe, Ya7ilaamenne Qoore yelides.
Elfaazey Temaane, Omaare, Xaafe, Ga7itaame, Qenaaze, Teminaa7enne Amaaleeqe geetettiza attuma nayta yelides.
Era7u7eeley Nahaate, Zaraahe, Shammahanne Miizahe geetettiza attuma nayta yelides.
Eedoomen Koyro De7ida Asata
Eedoomen koyro de7ida Seyre attuma nayti Looxa, Shobaale, Xiba7oone, Aana, Diisho, Exeerenne Dishaane.
Looxaane attuma nayti Hoorenne Homaame; Teminaa7a Looxaanes michcho.
Shobaale attuma nayti Aliwa, Manahaate, Eebaale, Sheefenne Oonname. Xiba7oone attuma nayti Aayanne Aana.
Aanay Dishoone yelides; Dishoone attuma nayti Hemda, Eshibaane, Yitiraanenne Kaaraane.
Exeere attuma nayti Bilihaane, Za7iwaanenne Yaqine. Dishaane attuma nayti Uuxenne Araane.
Eedoome Dere Kawota
Isra7eelen ay kawoykka kawotanaappe kase Eedoome biittan kawotida kawoti hayssafe kaalli xaafettidayta. Bi7oore naa Beelay kawotides; iza katamaa sunththay Dinaabe.
Beelay hayqqiin izappe kaallidi Booxira dere as Zaraahe naa Yobaabey kawotides.
Yobaabey hayqqiin izappe kaallidi Temaane dere as Hushamey kawotides.
Hushamey hayqqiin izappe kaallidi Mo7aabe deren Midiyaameta xoonida Badaade naa Hadaadey kawotides; iza katamaya Awite geetettawus.
Hadaadey hayqqiin izappe kaallidi Maasireeqe dere as Sha7uley kawotides.
Sha7uley hayqqiin izappe kaallidi Efiraaxise shaafa matan diza Erahoobote dere as Sa7ooli kawotides.
Sa7ooli hayqqiin izappe kaallidi Akiboore naa Ba7aali-Hanaaney kawotides.
Ba7aali-Hanaaney hayqqiin izappe kaallidi Paa7u dere as Hadaadey kawotides; iza machcheyakka Mahexabi7eela Mezahaabe naa Maxireeda biyo; hessafe guye Hadaadey hayqqides.
Eedoomen keehi erettiza halaqati Teminaa7e, Aliwa, Yeteete,
Oholibaame, Eela, Pinoone,
Qenaaze, Temaane, Mibizaare,
Magidi7eelenne Iraame geetetteettes.
